# oncallalert_service (Data Source)

Looks up a service by exact name (case-insensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncallalert_service" "legacy" {
  name = "Legacy API"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
